title: Trump’s Fixation on Arctic Ships Led to Billions in No-Bid Contracts
partialText: The president decided to buy 11 polar icebreakers after a game of golf with Finland’s president. Experts say it’s far from clear the United States needs so many.

title: Justice Dept. Subpoenas Times Freelancer in Effort to Identify Sources
partialText: A previously undisclosed subpoena, involving reporting on a failed SEAL Team 6 mission in North Korea, reflects the government’s expanding campaign to investigate leaks of secrets.

title: Scope of Hacks on U.S. Water Supply Widens as Evidence Points to Iran
partialText: Michigan and Minnesota are among at least seven states coping with cyberattacks aimed at disrupting water systems nationwide.

title: In Iran, the U.S. Appears Headed for a Strategic Defeat, Allies Fear
partialText: With none of President Trump’s aims accomplished and the Strait of Hormuz closed, U.S. allies see dysfunction and vulnerability from the war.

title: Evidence Indicates U.S. Dropped Bomb on Residential Area in Iran, Killing 3 Civilians
partialText: The weapon, one of the largest in the U.S.’s arsenal, struck a house in a heavily populated area, according to a Times analysis.

title: Kuwait Says It Downed Iranian Drones as Mideast Braces for Possible Escalation
partialText: The wave of strikes came as President Trump threatened to intensify the American campaign against Iran. U.S. embassies in the region warned of the “potential for unforeseen escalation.”

title: Fact-Checking Trump’s Claims About the Effect of the Iran War on Oil Prices, Munitions and More
partialText: The president misleadingly blamed the Biden administration’s weapons transfers to Ukraine for current concerns over munitions stockpiles, among other claims about the Iran war.

title: She Voted for a Justice Who Overturned Roe. Now it Haunts Her on the Trail.
partialText: Senator Susan Collins, who supports abortion rights, endorsed Brett Kavanaugh’s nomination for the Supreme Court. It has emerged as a major issue in her campaign for re-election.

title: Why Mitch McConnell Isn’t Giving Up His Senate Seat
partialText: Democrats are demanding that the Kentucky Republican resign. Others who were sidelined for far longer faced no such calls, but times are changing.

title: How Ukraine Is Making Inroads With MAGA and a Trump Ally, Laura Loomer
partialText: Ukraine and its supporters have invested years in trying to undo the skepticism of the country’s war effort harbored by President Trump’s MAGA movement and the president himself.

title: The U.S. Deported Him to Jail in Russia. Then He Escaped.
partialText: Facing a long prison sentence or a forced trip to the front line of a war he opposes, Artyom Vovchenko believed it was worth taking a risk.

title: Russian Missiles Kill 9 in Kyiv After Trump Backs Off Air-Defense Pledge
partialText: Ukraine’s supply of Patriot missile interceptors is dwindling, and on Friday, President Trump backed away from his promise to let Ukraine make them itself.

title: How 50,000 Migrants Surged Into Ceuta, a Spanish Exclave Near Morocco
partialText: On Thursday, tens of thousands of Moroccans broke into Ceuta, a Spanish territory that neighbors Morocco. By Friday evening, most of them had left, hungry and disappointed.

title: Spain Installs Floating Barrier in Ceuta After Influx of Migrants
partialText: Most of those who came to the territory, a Spanish exclave in Africa, have returned across the border to Morocco. At least 67 people died trying to enter, the authorities said.

title: Anthony Bourdain’s Wild Summers Still Echo in Provincetown
partialText: As a new film evokes his coming-of-age in this bohemian Cape Cod town, Pete Wells goes looking for the people and restaurants that shaped him.

title: To Find Happiness, I Stopped Talking. It Helped.
partialText: I had no idea what would help with my problems, but I knew what wouldn’t: talking about them. Which is why a silent retreat turned out to be exactly what I needed.

title: The Working Class Is Fleeing Trump
partialText: Democrats have an anger problem. Republicans have a Trump problem.

title: Making Rounds
partialText: Errands get us out of our homes and into the world, on missions providing both serendipity and satisfaction.

title: Nirmal Purja, Renowned Mountaineer, Is Found Dead After Pakistan Avalanche
partialText: The British-Nepali mountaineer was one of 10 climbers who were struck by an avalanche on Thursday on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains.
